description: Allocated cost per data stream for one deployment, split into indexing, query and storage components and a blended total, using the same weighted formula as the Chargeback dashboards. This is the main tool for answering 'which data streams cost the most' and for finding candidates to shorten retention on or move to a cheaper tier.

configuration.query:
FROM billing_realized_pool_lookup
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_deployment_contribution_lookup ON composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_datastream_contribution_lookup ON composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON @timestamp >= conf_start_date AND @timestamp <= conf_end_date
| WHERE DATE_DIFF("day", @timestamp, NOW()) <= ?days AND deployment_id == ?deployment_id
| EVAL heap_util = COALESCE(heap_used_pct_p95, 100) / 100, disk_util = COALESCE(disk_used_pct_p95, 100) / 100
| EVAL w_sum = conf_utilization_memory_weight + conf_utilization_storage_weight
| EVAL utilization_score = CASE(w_sum > 0, (conf_utilization_memory_weight * heap_util + conf_utilization_storage_weight * disk_util) / w_sum, 1.0)
| EVAL chargeable_pool = data_tier_capacity_ecu * COALESCE(utilization_score, 1.0)
| EVAL rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| EVAL idx_cost = CASE(deployment_sum_indexing_time > 0, TO_DOUBLE(datastream_sum_indexing_time) / deployment_sum_indexing_time * chargeable_pool * rate, 0.0)
| EVAL qry_cost = CASE(deployment_sum_query_time > 0, TO_DOUBLE(datastream_sum_query_time) / deployment_sum_query_time * chargeable_pool * rate, 0.0)
| EVAL sto_cost = CASE(deployment_sum_data_set_store_size > 0, TO_DOUBLE(datastream_sum_data_set_store_size) / deployment_sum_data_set_store_size * chargeable_pool * rate, 0.0)
| EVAL blended = (idx_cost * conf_indexing_weight + qry_cost * conf_query_weight + sto_cost * conf_storage_weight) / (conf_indexing_weight + conf_query_weight + conf_storage_weight)
| STATS indexing_cost = SUM(idx_cost), query_cost = SUM(qry_cost), storage_cost = SUM(sto_cost), blended_cost = SUM(blended), storage_bytes = MAX(datastream_sum_data_set_store_size)
    BY datastream
| WHERE blended_cost > 0
| SORT blended_cost DESC
| LIMIT 25

deployment_id.description: Deployment ID or Serverless project ID
